column1: # Connected negotiated-compression command I/O test evidence.

column8: note

All prior packet vectors remain under the consolidated owner and the server integration additionally sends real compressed command and response streams through Connection dispatch. Go-only BytesConn, bufio, deadlines, metrics, logging, dynamic config, and error-stack integration remain external.
The exact 27-byte source buffer still executes repeatedly through PacketIoWriter; Go benchmark timing, allocation reporting, bufio sizing, and a cross-language performance threshold remain open.
Exact reserved-header single-frame bytes and a MaxPayloadLen logical packet with terminal zero frame remain covered by PacketIoWriter.
The 16 MiB zlib source payload retains exact envelope semantics; Rust's encoder emits a valid but byte-length-different stream from Go flate.
The complete uncompressed, verbatim compressed, zlib, and zstd read matrix remains covered through PacketIoReader.
Exact single and MaxPayloadLen continuation vectors preserve payloads and inner sequence advancement.
The exact zero-uncompressed-length envelope remains a verbatim inner packet stream.
The exact Go zlib fixture still decodes to its COM_QUERY payload.
The exact Go zstd fixture still decodes to its COM_QUERY payload.
Short data and the exact 50-byte boundary remain verbatim while 51 bytes enters compression.
Both codecs retain header and round-trip semantics; Rust encoder byte lengths differ from Go's encoders.
The zlib vector preserves sequence, decoded length, compression, and payload while exact Go compressed bytes remain different.
The zstd vector preserves sequence, decoded length, compression, and payload while exact Go compressed bytes remain different.
The exact verbatim envelope is still read across separate inner-header and payload regions.
Both exact compressed fixtures still decode into their inner stream and query payload.
The exact Go zlib fixture preserves the inner header and repeated-byte query.
The exact Go zstd fixture preserves the inner header and repeated-byte query.
The MariaDB compressed inner-sequence exception and strict uncompressed and outer sequence failures remain covered.
None, zlib, and zstd selection plus requested zstd-level preservation execute from handshake state; Go session-variable statistics map registration and status key rendering remain external.
